import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
# Lower trishomocubane: A B C D E F G H I J K.
edges=[(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,0),(1,5),(5,6),(6,7),(7,4),(7,8),(8,3),(8,9),(9,5),(9,10),(10,2)]
# Upper bicyclo[4.1.0]heptane: 11 apex, 12 left junction, 13 right junction.
edges += [(11,12),(11,13),(12,13),(12,14),(14,15),(15,16),(16,17),(17,13)]
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for _ in range(18):rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('C'))
for i,j in edges: rw.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(0,11,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# Right-handed drawing coordinates: x to the right, y upward, z toward viewer.
pix=[(487,852),(269,965),(321,1202),(535,1219),(635,998),(147,904),(322,816),(477,974),(412,1118),(190,1100),(157,1291),(515,646),(436,452),(642,481),(359,258),(489,94),(694,123),(771,317)]
xyz=np.array([((x-487)/145,(852-y)/145, .65 if i in [0,1,2,3,4,11,12,13,14,15,16,17] else -.65) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(pix)])
conf=Chem.Conformer(18)
for i,p in enumerate(xyz):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,p)
m.AddConformer(conf)
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
conf=m.GetConformer()
# Explicit H wedges at the two cyclopropane junctions.
for idx in [12,13]:
    hi=[n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==1][0]
    p=xyz[idx].copy();p[2]+=1.08
    conf.SetAtomPosition(hi,p)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('stereocenters',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
# Optimize both the drawing-seeded structure and independent ETKDG structures.
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=180;p.numThreads=4;p.useRandomCoords=True
ens=Chem.Mol(m); ens.RemoveAllConformers()
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(ens,numConfs=80,params=p)
print('embedded',len(ids))
results=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(ens,numThreads=4,maxIters=2500)
print('energies', sorted(results,key=lambda t:t[1])[:10])
idx=min(range(len(results)),key=lambda i:results[i][1])
Chem.MolToXYZFile(ens,'candidate.xyz',confId=idx)
Chem.MolToMolFile(ens,'candidate.mol',confId=idx)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'template.mol')
np.save('template_coords.npy',np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions()))
PY
python build.py

python - <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
import numpy as np
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('ideal.mol',removeHs=False)
ls=open('xtb_opt/xtbopt.xyz').read().splitlines();xyz=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:4]] for l in ls[2:]])
for i,p in enumerate(xyz):m.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(i,p)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True);Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('Final stereocenters',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True))
for b in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx();d=np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j]);
 if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=='C':print(i,j,str(b.GetBondType()),round(d,3))
# Geometric cis H check.
hi=[[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors() if a.GetAtomicNum()==1][0] for i in [12,13]]
n=np.cross(xyz[12]-xyz[11],xyz[13]-xyz[11]);n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
print('H cis projections',[(xyz[h]-xyz[a])@n for a,h in zip([12,13],hi)])
# XYZ formatting, include every H.
xyz-=xyz.mean(axis=0)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nC18H22; geometry from mol_0180.png; all hydrogens explicit; angstrom\n')
 for a,p in zip(m.GetAtoms(),xyz):f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p[0]: .9f} {p[1]: .9f} {p[2]: .9f}\n')
print('answer.xyz exists, atoms:',m.GetNumAtoms())
